label: Introduction
subgoals: Meet sine and cosine on the unit circle
Set radius 1 so coordinates equal sin and cos
Allow theta + 2k*pi to revisit each point

label: Definition of sine and cosine
subgoals: Drop perpendiculars from P to both axes
Read the y-leg as sin(theta), the x-leg as cos(theta)

label: Fundamental trigonometric identity
subgoals: Add squared legs for sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1
Use the circle equation x^2 + y^2 = 1 as the proof
Carry the identity into double-angle forms
